definitions.gloss: random street attacker; a random attack on passers-by
definitions.explanation: Someone who suddenly attacks strangers in the street, usually with a knife, for no reason connected to the victims; also the attack itself. A word of news reports, as in {通|とお}り{魔|ま}{事件|じけん} (a random street attack).

examples.japanese: {通|とお}り{魔|ま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: To be attacked by a stranger in the street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{通|とお}り{魔|ま}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: There was a random street attack in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {通|とお}り{魔|ま}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{夜道|よみち}→夜道：17541_yomichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怖|こわ}く→怖い：00864_kowai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After the random attack, I became afraid to walk alone at night.

notes:
⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ (passing by) + ⟦{魔|ま}→魔：19358_ma⟧ (demon): an attacker who strikes like a demon passing in the street.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通|とお}り{魔|ま}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: a random street attack
- {通|とお}り{魔|ま}⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧: a random killing of passers-by
- {通|とお}り{魔|ま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺|さ}される→刺す：02111_sasu⟧: to be stabbed by a random attacker

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無差別|むさべつ}→無差別：13492_musabetsu⟧: indiscriminate; ⟦{無差別|むさべつ}→無差別：13492_musabetsu⟧⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧ is the broader term for killing people at random
